name: MeetGeek Cloud
description: Access and extract insights from your meetings — directly in Claude. Search past calls, pull full transcripts with speaker labels, surface action items, and get AI-generated summaries without switching tabs. Whether you're following up on a sales call, catching up on a missed sync, or tracking decisions across your team, MeetGeek makes it happen instantly. Turn every conversation into structured, searchable, and immediately actionable intelligence — right inside your AI workflow.

_published_faq.name: How do I add MeetGeek Cloud to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add MeetGeek Cloud to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.meetgeek.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the MeetGeek Cloud MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: MeetGeek Cloud provides these MCP tools: fetch_meeting_highlights, fetch_meeting_insights, fetch_meeting_metadata, fetch_meeting_summary, fetch_meeting_transcript, fetch_team_meetings, fetch_user_meetings, and submit_recording_for_analysis.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to MeetGeek Cloud?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to MeetGeek Cloud in communication on the Manufact MCP catalog include AgentLine: Phone Numbers for AI Agents, JooVoice, OpenMail, Granola, and Fleet Connected Apps.

_published_faq.name: Does MeetGeek Cloud MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: MeetGeek Cloud requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
MeetGeek Cloud is developed by MeetGeek.ai. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
